# Bundled frontend dependencies

These assets are served locally so the interface needs no external CDN connection:

| Library | Version | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Bootstrap CSS | 5.3.3 | MIT |
| Bootstrap Icons | 1.11.3 | MIT |
| Chart.js UMD | 4.4.8 | MIT |
| DM Sans | Google Fonts distribution | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| DM Serif Display | Google Fonts distribution | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |

The original license notices are retained in `licenses/`. Font files are in `fonts/`.
Source projects: [Bootstrap](https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap), [Bootstrap Icons](https://github.com/twbs/icons), [Chart.js](https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js), [Google Fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts).
